    SELECT name, version, test_score as stack_test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, MAX(test_score) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version
),
combined AS (
    SELECT s.name, s.version, s.stack_test_score, n.max_non_stack_score
    FROM stack_scores s
    JOIN non_stack_max n ON s.name = n.name AND s.version = n.version
),
status_assigned AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        version,
        stack_test_score,
        max_non_stack_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN max_non_stack_score < stack_test_score THEN 'strong'
            WHEN max_non_stack_score = stack_test_score THEN 'soft'
            ELSE 'other'
        END as status
    FROM combined
),
status_summary AS (
    SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM status_assigned
    GROUP BY status
)
SELECT * FROM status_summary ORDER BY cnt DESC
